description.en: Brand look of the splash and theme. Follow backend (default) switches with the active kernel — Claude boots orange (CLAUDE CODE title, Claude girl), Codex boots lavender (CODEX title, "Build anything with Codex"); the other values pin one look. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 开屏与主题的品牌外观。跟随后端（默认）随当前内核自动切——Claude 后端整套换橙（CLAUDE CODE 大标题、Claude 娘立绘），Codex 后端整套换薰衣草紫（CODEX 大标题、"Build anything with Codex" 标语）；选固定档则锁定一种外观。立即生效。

description.en: Total characters of recent Q/A pairs a /btw follow-up carries, 1000-200000 (default 24000). Whole older pairs drop first; the per-answer cap derives as min(8k, budget/2). The btw panel is enabled by default and can be changed in sidePanel.panels. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 追问携带的最近问答总字符预算，1000-200000（默认 24000）。超出时从最旧的整组开始裁剪；单条答案上限内部派生为 min(8k, 预算/2)。btw 面板默认启用，可在 sidePanel.panels 中调整。立即生效。

description.en: Completed Q/A pairs a /btw follow-up explicitly carries, 1-8 (default 4). Pairs beyond the window are omitted from the ask (the thread and the panel still keep them). The btw panel is enabled by default and can be changed in sidePanel.panels. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 追问显式携带的最近完成问答组数，1-8（默认 4）。窗口外的旧组不进请求（线程与面板仍保留全文）。btw 面板默认启用，可在 sidePanel.panels 中调整。立即生效。

description.en: How fenced code blocks in replies frame themselves. Light (default): an open rail — corner + language label on top, a left rail with one padding column per row, no right wall or bottom edge (costs no extra height). Full: closes the box with a right wall that stays continuous across wrapped rows and a bottom edge under the block. Very narrow terminals always keep the plain fence, whatever this says. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 回复里代码块的边框形式。轻框（默认）：开放式栏杆——顶部角标加语言标签，每行左侧竖杆加一格内边距，无右墙无底边（不多占高度）。全框：封闭盒子——右墙在折行处保持连续，底部封边。终端太窄时恒为纯 fence（不受此设置影响）。立即生效。

description.en: DeepSeek brand: whale allows the maid portrait; deepy/whaleGirl replace it. Claude uses its own art; Codex uses its own raster portrait or maid character-art fallback. Look of the companion panel pet (the panel is enabled by default and can be changed in sidePanel.panels): deepy (default, the deepy whale kit), whale (the same layered pixel whale as the splash) or whaleGirl (the user-provided whale-girl sticker pack, 22 animations). Applies immediately.
description.zh: DeepSeek 品牌：whale 才能用女仆娘立绘；deepy/whaleGirl 会替换它。Claude 使用自己的图案；Codex 优先显示自己的真图，不可用时回落女仆娘字符画。伙伴面板里宠物的外形（面板默认启用，可在 sidePanel.panels 中调整）：deepy（默认，deepy 小鲸鱼素材包）、whale（与开屏同款的分层像素鲸鱼）或 whaleGirl（用户提供的鲸娘表情包，22 个动画）。立即生效。

description.en: Edit/Write tool cards: auto picks by terminal width, or force one layout.
description.zh: Edit/Write 工具卡的 diff 呈现：auto 按终端宽度选择，或强制一种布局。

description.en: Choices come from the current backend and model. A saved value absent from that catalog remains visible and stored until you change it. On DSH, Auto follows the persisted /effort choice, then cordis.yml effort, then the model default. On Claude/Codex, Auto at startup and resumed sessions preserve backend preferences; explicitly choosing Auto resets the model default. Explicit changes apply to the next request; unsupported preferences fall back only to a lower offered tier, or the model default, with a notice. While the catalog is loading or unavailable, only Auto is selectable.
description.zh: 选项来自当前后端和模型目录。目录没有的已存值仍显示并保留，直到你主动修改。DSH 自动依次采用持久化的 /effort 选择、cordis.yml effort 配置、模型默认。Claude/Codex 启动采用自动模式或恢复会话时保留后端偏好；在设置中主动选择自动会重置为模型默认。明确修改会作用于下一请求；不支持的偏好仅向下回落到可用档位，否则回到模型默认，并给出提示。目录加载中或不可用时仅可选自动。

description.en: On: the ⛶ affordance in the input row and the expand-editor shortcut (default Ctrl+Shift+E) expand the draft into a whole-screen editor (Enter = newline, Ctrl+Enter = send). Off: both entry points disappear. On by default.
description.zh: 开启：输入行尾 ⛶ 按钮与全屏编辑快捷键（默认 Ctrl+Shift+E）把草稿展开成整屏编辑器（Enter 换行、Ctrl+Enter 发送）。关闭：两个入口都不显示。默认开启。

description.en: Terminal cards (Bash/PowerShell): collapse a multi-line command header to its first line + count; Ctrl+O or a click expands it.
description.zh: 终端卡（Bash/PowerShell）：多行命令头部折叠为首行 + 计数；Ctrl+O 或点击卡片展开。

description.en: On: app takes the whole screen (vim/less style), in-app mouse. Off: native scrollback; full-page screens keep the mouse. Restart to apply.
description.zh: 开启：接管整个终端（同 vim/less），应用内鼠标；关闭：终端原生滚动选择；整屏页两种模式都有鼠标。重启生效。

description.en: What sits behind photos and illustrations in the chat. Transparent paints only the pixels of the image itself — the terminal background or wallpaper shows through at anti-aliased edges and transparent corners; Terminal colour composites onto the terminal background first, which keeps soft edges smooth (Sixel has no partial alpha). Applies immediately.
description.zh: 聊天里的照片/插图背后垫什么。透明：只画图片自己的像素，抗锯齿边缘和透明圆角处透出终端底色或壁纸；终端底色：先合成到终端背景色上，柔和边缘更平滑（Sixel 没有部分透明）。立即生效。

description.en: Consecutive background-job cards render as one group with a summary header. Auto folds a run of 3+ once every job settled; Always folds any run of 2+ right away; Never keeps every card (click the header to fold one run by hand, Ctrl+O to expand all).
description.zh: 连续的后台任务卡渲染成一组并带汇总头。自动：整组落定且 3 个以上时折叠成一行；总是：2 个以上立即折叠；从不：每张卡都留着（点组头可手工折叠单组，Ctrl+O 展开全部）。

description.en: UI language for the whole interface — applies immediately and is saved.
description.zh: 整个界面的显示语言——立即生效并保存。

description.en: On: an ordinary launch (no --resume, no first prompt) starts on the launchpad — the landing page where the first sentence gets typed, with the Continue / Sessions / Settings / Kernel row. Off: boots straight into the chat page. A resume target always skips the launchpad either way. On by default. Restart to apply.
description.zh: 开启：普通启动（不带 --resume、不带首句）先落启动页——输入第一句话的落地页，带「继续上次 / 会话与工作区 / 设置 / 内核」一行；关闭：直接进入聊天页。无论开关，指定恢复的会话总是直接打开。默认开启。重启生效。

description.en: What sits behind a formula rendered as an image. Transparent paints only the formula and lets the terminal background (a wallpaper included) show through; Terminal colour composites it onto the terminal background first, which is calmer on busy backgrounds and keeps anti-aliased edges smooth (Sixel has no partial alpha). Applies immediately.
description.zh: 公式渲染成图片时背后垫什么。透明：只画公式本身，终端底色或壁纸直接透出来；终端底色：先合成到终端背景色上，在花哨的背景上更稳，抗锯齿边缘也更平滑（Sixel 没有部分透明）。立即生效。

description.en: How large a display formula is set when it renders as an image (LaTeX math → Image, both on this page). Text size matches the body text; Large and Extra large set display math bigger, which also hands the terminal more device pixels for its strokes — the only sharpness lever a terminal image has. Inline formulas are unaffected: their single row of cells caps the resolution. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 块级公式渲染成图片时的大小（配合 LaTeX 公式的「图片」）。与正文同尺寸：和正文一样大；放大 / 更大：显示公式排得更大，终端也因此有更多像素画笔画，观感更锐利——这是终端图片唯一的清晰度杠杆。行内公式不受影响（只能占一行，像素上限被卡死）。立即生效。

description.en: How LaTeX math in replies ($…$, \(…\), $$…$$, \[…\]) renders. Auto: the best available renderer — today Unicode text with symbols, sub/superscripts, stacked fractions and limits, matrices, cases. Image: typeset block formulas and eligible one-row inline formulas as images when the terminal has graphics — Kitty (Kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm, iTerm2…) or Sixel (Windows Terminal 1.22+, xterm, foot, WezTerm); Unicode elsewhere and for formulas that do not fit. Unicode: always Unicode text. Source: keep the TeX as written. Unsupported, still-streaming, or too-wide formulas keep their source. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 回复中的 LaTeX 公式（$…$、\(…\)、$$…$$、\[…\]）怎么显示。自动：用当前最好的渲染方式——目前是 Unicode 文本（符号、上下标、竖排的分数与上下限、矩阵、分段函数）。图片：终端支持图形时把块级公式与能压入一行的行内公式排版成图片——Kitty（Kitty、Ghostty、WezTerm、iTerm2 等）或 Sixel（Windows Terminal 1.22+、xterm、foot、WezTerm）；其他终端与放不下的公式用 Unicode。Unicode：固定用 Unicode 文本。源码：保留原始 TeX。不支持、仍在流式输出或比终端宽的公式保留源码。立即生效。

description.en: Render ```mermaid fences in replies as box-drawing diagrams (flowchart, sequence, state, class, ER, pie, mindmap, timeline, gitGraph). Diagrams wider than the terminal, or of an unsupported type, keep the fenced source. Applies immediately. On by default.
description.zh: 把回复中的 ```mermaid 代码块画成字符图（flowchart、sequence、state、class、ER、pie、mindmap、timeline、gitGraph）。比终端宽或类型不支持的图保留源码。立即生效。默认开启。

description.en: Interface only: hide the header splash, emoji glyphs and decorative colors, and trim the status bar to model + cwd; code highlight and tool colors stay. NOT the agent preset — the kernel's own `minimal` preset is a separate, model-facing choice that decides which tools the model can use (see /preset).
description.zh: 只精简界面：隐藏开屏头部、emoji 状态符与装饰性配色，底栏只留模型与目录；代码高亮与工具配色保留。这是界面开关，不是 Agent 预设——模型能用哪些工具由内核预设决定（见 /preset）。

description.en: Auto uses a native toast in local Windows sessions and the client terminal protocol over SSH. Ghostty/WezTerm use OSC 777, Kitty OSC 99, and iTerm2/Warp OSC 9 with a title prefix; other terminals ring the bell. Explicit Windows uses a toast on the Windows host, including over SSH. The first toast registers a per-user HKCU ID and can take about 3 seconds. It yields only for DSH sessions with an enabled, active cc-dsh-notifier; a failed toast falls back to the bell. Terminal settings still apply; tmux OSC notifications need allow-passthrough. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 自动：Windows 本地会话用系统 toast，SSH 会话改走客户端终端协议。Ghostty/WezTerm 用 OSC 777，Kitty 用 OSC 99，iTerm2/Warp 用带标题前缀的 OSC 9，其他终端响铃。显式 Windows 仍在 Windows 主机弹窗，包括 SSH。首次 toast 会注册当前用户的 HKCU 标识，约延迟 3 秒；仅 DSH 会话遇到已启用、正在运行的 cc-dsh-notifier 时让位；弹窗失败回落响铃。实际效果依终端设置；tmux 的 OSC 通知需 allow-passthrough。立即生效。

description.en: Inset the whole UI from the terminal edges. ←/→ cycles presets (none / slim / normal / roomy); Enter types a custom spec `NxM`: N columns per side, M rows top/bottom (e.g. 3x1, max 8x4; a bare `N` keeps rows at 1). Empty resets to the default `normal`. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 让整个界面相对终端四边内缩。←/→ 循环预设（none / slim / normal / roomy）；Enter 输入自定义 `NxM`：左右各 N 列、上下各 M 行（如 3x1，上限 8x4；只填 N 则上下保持 1 行）。清空恢复默认 normal。立即生效。

description.en: Show the session name on the prompt top border, right corner. Off by default.
description.zh: 在输入框顶边框右上角显示会话名。默认关闭。

description.en: On: opening/resuming a session automatically summarizes its recent activity into a dim line at the bottom of the transcript (hover/click to view or apply the suggested title). Off: use /recap manually.
description.zh: 开启：打开/恢复会话时自动把最近活动总结成一行灰字显示在会话底部（可悬停/点击查看或应用建议标题）；关闭：手动使用 /recap。

description.en: Right gutter of the fullscreen transcript: per-turn timeline ticks, a proportional scrollbar, or nothing.
description.zh: 全屏转录区右侧边栏：按轮次的时间线节点、比例滚动条，或留空。

label.zh: 加载上下文面板快捷键

description.en: Toggle the startup loaded-context panel. Default: ctrl+p.
description.zh: 切换启动时的已加载上下文面板。默认 ctrl+p。

description.en: On the launchpad, resume the most recent session. Default: alt+r. Only bound while the launchpad is up.
description.zh: 在启动页上继续最近一条会话。默认 alt+r。仅在启动页生效。

description.en: Open the subagent dashboard. Default: ctrl+a.
description.zh: 打开子代理面板。默认 ctrl+a。

description.en: Edit the draft in $VISUAL/$EDITOR. Default: ctrl+g.
description.zh: 在 $VISUAL/$EDITOR 外部编辑器中编辑草稿。默认 ctrl+g。

description.en: Toggle the fullscreen draft editor (Enter inserts a newline, Ctrl+Enter sends). Default: ctrl+shift+e.
description.zh: 切换全屏草稿编辑器（Enter 换行、Ctrl+Enter 发送）。默认 ctrl+shift+e。

description.en: Open the prompt-history search. Default: ctrl+r.
description.zh: 打开输入历史搜索。默认 ctrl+r。

description.en: Clipboard paste (text, file paths, images). Default: ctrl+v, alt+v. Alt+V works where the terminal eats Ctrl+V.
description.zh: 剪贴板粘贴（文本、文件路径、图片）。默认 ctrl+v, alt+v。终端吞掉 Ctrl+V 时可用 Alt+V。

label.zh: 面板正文向下翻页快捷键

description.en: Page down through question text or a compact approval preview without moving the choice focus. Default: alt+down.
description.zh: 向下翻阅问卷正文或紧凑审批预览，不移动选项焦点。默认 alt+down。

label.zh: 面板正文向上翻页快捷键

description.en: Page up through question text or a compact approval preview without moving the choice focus. Default: alt+up.
description.zh: 向上翻阅问卷正文或紧凑审批预览，不移动选项焦点。默认 alt+up。

description.en: Fold/unfold the pending question panel. Default: ctrl+k.
description.zh: 折叠/展开等待回答的提问面板。默认 ctrl+k。

description.en: Clear and repaint the terminal. Default: ctrl+l.
description.zh: 清空并重绘终端。默认 ctrl+l。

description.en: Toggle show-all-messages. Default: ctrl+e.
description.zh: 切换显示全部消息。默认 ctrl+e。

description.en: Smart three-state sidebar toggle: closed → open+focus → focus chat → closed. Default: ctrl+b. tmux users should remap it (the prefix eats Ctrl+B).
description.zh: 侧栏智能三态：关闭 → 打开并聚焦 → 焦点回聊天 → 关闭。默认 ctrl+b。tmux 用户请改键（前缀会吞掉它）。

description.en: Zoom the active side panel (chat keeps its minimum width). Default: alt+z.
description.zh: 缩放当前侧栏面板（聊天列保留最小宽度）。默认 alt+z。

description.en: Star the project via the gh CLI (same action as /star and the splash line's click). Default: alt+s.
description.zh: 用 gh 给项目点 star（与 /star、开屏标语点击同一个动作）。默认 alt+s。

description.en: Fold running todos; hide/restore the idle goal/todo footer. Default: ctrl+q.
description.zh: 运行时折叠待办，空闲时隐藏/恢复目标与待办底部面板。默认 ctrl+q。

description.en: Open the trajectory scene. Default: ctrl+t.
description.zh: 打开轨迹场景。默认 ctrl+t。

description.en: Toggle expanded transcript mode. Default: ctrl+o.
description.zh: 切换展开转录模式。默认 ctrl+o。

description.en: Undo the prompt draft one word-level step at a time (text, caret and images together). Draft-only: submitted or history-recalled text is out of scope (Esc Esc rewinds turns, Ctrl+R recalls history). Default: ctrl+z.
description.zh: 按词撤销输入框草稿（文本、光标、图片一起回退）。只作用于草稿：提交或用历史召回后不可撤销；与 Esc Esc 回溯、Ctrl+R 历史召回不是一回事。默认 ctrl+z。

description.en: Whether a session opens with the sidebar already expanded (Ctrl+B or /panel toggles it any time). Off by default, so the upgrade leaves the layout exactly as it was until asked; the in-session toggle is not persisted. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 打开会话时侧栏是否已展开（随时可用 Ctrl+B 或 /panel 切换）。默认关闭，升级后界面与原来完全一致，除非主动开启；会话内的切换不会写回设置。立即生效。

description.en: Default `*` shows every panel — the built-ins plus plugin panels registered later. Unticking a checkbox writes an explicit list: from then on a panel registered after the fact stays off until ticked (an unlisted registered panel shows unchecked, an unlisted well-formed id stays as a checked placeholder). Temporary panels show their title and a run-local number; their checkboxes affect this run only and are never saved, and an old actN placeholder must be removed and the current panel selected again. The Advanced row edits the raw list (`*` = all, persistent ids only). Applies immediately.
description.zh: 默认 `*` 显示全部面板——内置面板加上之后注册的插件面板。取消勾选会写成显式列表：此后新注册的面板保持关闭，直到勾选（已注册但未列出的面板显示为未勾选；未列出但格式合法的 id 仍保留为已勾选占位行）。临时面板显示标题和本次运行编号，其勾选只影响当前运行、不保存；旧 actN 占位项应移除后重新选择当前面板。「高级」行编辑原始列表（`*` = 全部，仅持久 id）。立即生效。

description.en: Chat column as a fraction of the content width: 0.1-0.95, default 0.68. Type a decimal such as `0.6`; drag the divider or use +/- while the panel has focus to resize for the current session. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 聊天列占内容宽度的比例：0.1-0.95，默认 0.68。输入小数如 `0.6`；拖拽分隔线，或在面板获得焦点时用 +/-，可在当前会话内实时调宽。立即生效。

description.en: Master switch of the split layout: on (default) Ctrl+B and /panel open the side column next to the chat; off makes both fall back to the fullscreen panels. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 分栏总开关：开启（默认）时 Ctrl+B 与 /panel 在聊天右侧展开侧栏；关闭时两者都退回整屏面板。立即生效。

description.en: Reveal live replies, expanded thinking, and tool-call bodies through an even ~30fps flow instead of per-burst jumps; one-shot non-streaming replies paint as a flow too. Replay/history always paints complete. On by default.
description.zh: 把实时回复、展开的思考与工具卡正文按 ~30fps 匀速揭示，不再随供应商突发一跳一跳；一次性到达的非流式回复也会平滑打出。回放/历史内容始终完整直出。默认开启。

description.en: Big-text face on the header splash. Daily rotates by local date (default); pick a face to pin that one. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 开屏头部的大字字面。按天轮换（默认）随本地日期换款；选某一款即固定那一款。立即生效。

description.en: Show the idle working-activity summary.
description.zh: 显示空闲时的工作活动摘要。

description.en: Show prompt-cache hit information.
description.zh: 显示提示词缓存命中信息。

description.en: Prefer the compact status presentation when terminal space allows.
description.zh: 终端空间允许时优先使用紧凑状态栏布局。

description.en: Show the segmented context progress bar on its own footer row.
description.zh: 在底部单独一行显示分段上下文进度条。

description.en: Show current context-window consumption.
description.zh: 显示当前上下文窗口占用情况。

description.en: Show the estimated session spend (≈¥) next to the token totals. Only appears for official DeepSeek providers whose model has a known price; the estimate follows the official per-million-token rates (peak/idle hours) and is not a bill.
description.zh: 在 Token 总量旁显示本会话花费估算（≈¥）。仅在使用 DeepSeek 官方 API key 且模型有已知单价时显示；按官方每百万 token 单价（高峰/空闲时段）估算，非账单。

description.en: Show the session working directory.
description.zh: 显示当前会话的工作目录。

description.en: Show the current git branch when available.
description.zh: 可用时显示当前 Git 分支。

description.en: Show a compact goal chip (phase glyph + rounds) in the status footer while a goal exists.
description.zh: 存在 Goal 时，在底部状态栏显示紧凑的 Goal 状态（阶段符号与轮次）。

description.en: Show the active non-default session mode.
description.zh: 显示当前启用的非默认会话模式。

description.en: Show the live model id in the status bar.
description.zh: 在状态栏显示当前模型标识。

description.en: Show footer fields contributed by plugins. Turning this off does not uninstall anything.
description.zh: 显示插件贡献的底栏字段；关闭不会卸载任何插件。

description.en: Three ";"-separated groups — left group tail; right group head; right group tail — with comma-separated keys inside: `a,b;c;d`. Empty shows nothing; "*" shows every field (default, fields registered later included). A listed key follows the group it sits in, overriding its plugin-declared slot.
description.zh: 用 ";" 分成三组——左组末尾；右组开头；右组末尾——组内逗号分隔：`a,b;c;d`。留空则一个都不显示；"*" 表示全部（默认，含以后注册的字段）。被列出的字段以名单里的组为准，覆盖插件声明的槽位。

description.en: Show the short session id (# + first 8 chars) — it matches the session log filename for --resume.
description.zh: 显示短会话 ID（# + 前 8 位）——与日志文件名对应，方便 --resume 定位。

description.en: Show the current session title.
description.zh: 显示当前会话标题。

description.en: Control only the idle `? for shortcuts` reminder; pressing ? and the Esc shortcut hints are unaffected.
description.zh: 仅控制空闲时的 `? for shortcuts` 提示；按 ? 打开快捷键以及 Esc 快捷提示均不受影响。

description.en: Show the live reasoning effort or thinking mode.
description.zh: 显示当前推理强度或思考模式。

description.en: Show running input and output token totals.
description.zh: 显示累计输入与输出 Token。

description.en: Show live and recent tokens-per-second metrics.
description.zh: 显示实时及近期每秒 Token 指标。

description.en: Show the animated mini trajectory strip at the footer edge.
description.zh: 在状态栏边缘显示动态迷你轨迹条。

description.en: Notify when successful live work finishes with no queued follow-up or active goal. The title is dsh-TUI · Task complete; the body previews the latest reply as plain text in one line, with Markdown formatting removed, up to 200 characters. OSC 777/9 may shorten it further to fit a 2048-byte sequence budget without splitting characters. No reply shows only the title; BEL only rings. Default: only while the terminal is unfocused. Off disables notifications; Always also notifies while focused or when focus reporting is unavailable. Replay, cancellation and errors stay quiet. Applies immediately.
description.zh: 实时任务成功结束、没有排队的后续输入或活动目标时提醒。标题为「dsh-TUI · 任务已完成」，正文显示最新回复的单行纯文本摘要，去掉 Markdown 样式，最多 200 字符；OSC 777/9 还会按完整序列的 2048 字节预算截短，不拆字符；没有回复时只显示标题，BEL 只响铃。默认仅在终端失去焦点时通知；关闭可禁用，每次完成则在终端聚焦或不支持焦点报告时也通知。回放、取消和失败不通知。立即生效。

description.en: Preview images in supported terminals. Use /restart to apply. Sending images is unaffected.
description.zh: 在支持的终端中预览图片。修改后用 /restart 生效；不影响向模型发送图片。

description.en: Preview shows 2-3 live lines; Full stays expanded until turn end. Click a streaming block to switch between preview and full.
description.zh: 预览模式显示 2-3 行动态思考；展开模式保持至轮末。点击流式思考块可在预览与全文间切换。

description.en: Choose whether tool-call cards add no, subtle, or strong background emphasis.
description.zh: 选择工具调用卡片不添加、轻微或明显的背景强调。

description.en: Show the quiet right-aligned ledger that closes each turn (tokens in/out, cache split, span, retries). Off by default — the /tokens and /status commands and the footer token hover keep reporting the same numbers either way.
description.zh: 在每回合末尾显示安静的右对齐用量小记（输入/输出、缓存分段、耗时、重试）。默认关闭——无论开关，/tokens、/status 与底栏 token 悬停都照常报告同样数字。

description.en: Header art. DeepSeek follows Companion skin and the maid toggle; Claude uses its own art; Codex uses its own raster portrait or maid character-art fallback. Off leaves a text-only header.
description.zh: 标题图形：DeepSeek 品牌随宠物皮肤与女仆娘开关，Claude 使用自己的图案；Codex 优先显示自己的真图，不可用时回落女仆娘字符画。关闭则只留文字标题。

description.en: DeepSeek brand: choose whale in Companion skin, then enable this toggle. Claude uses its own art; Codex uses its own raster portrait or maid character-art fallback. Swaps the pixel whale for the author-designed maid portrait, preferring the real raster (Kitty/Sixel) with character-art fallback.
description.zh: DeepSeek 品牌：选 whale 皮肤并开启本项。Claude 使用自己的图案；Codex 优先显示自己的真图，不可用时回落女仆娘字符画。把像素鲸鱼换成项目作者绘制的女仆娘立绘，优先用终端图像协议（Kitty/Sixel）渲染真图，不支持时回落字符画。

label.zh: 鲸鱼娘闲置动画（欢迎期）

description.en: Welcome-phase idle behaviors: after the intro the whale flutters its fins, thumps its tail, and dozes off when idle; clicking wakes a dozing whale and pops a heart. The first agent turn freezes it to the static standard frame.
description.zh: 欢迎期闲置行为：开屏后鲸鱼娘摆鱼鳍、偶尔拍尾巴，空闲会睡着冒 Z；点击唤醒睡着的鲸鱼娘并冒爱心。开始第一个任务后定格为静态标准帧。
